about: A05 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a05cafe
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. In a warm cafe a stylized 3D animated photographer sits at a small table holding a cappuccino, glancing worriedly at the rainy window. Outside, the client taps her phone and smiles. Suddenly a glowing pale lavender coin trails sparkle dust, flies in through the door and drops softly into the photographer's open palm. She gasps, her whole face lights up and she raises the coin in a happy toast, the client waving through the window. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm light, Same faces, same clothes, same place, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.

shots.name: a05m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a05diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. On a small diorama of a cosy cafe corner on a pale lavender backdrop, the tiny stylized 3D animated photographer holds up a glowing lavender coin and does a little happy wiggle at the table; steam curls from the cappuccino. The diorama does not change shape. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied.
